channel.title: Egypt - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Egypt, every source cited.

item.title: Amr Adib questions Egypt's stray dog crisis response
item.description: Media personality highlights ongoing debate and lack of solutions after a child's death.

item.title: Egypt to power 7,000 factories with 1,000MW solar energy
item.description: The 'Shams El-Senaa' initiative aims to cut industrial electricity costs and boost competitiveness.

item.title: Egypt launches free rabies vaccination for stray dogs
item.description: The week-long campaign aims to eliminate rabies nationwide by 2030 and includes public awareness activities.

item.title: Cyberattack caused Cairo billboard porn
item.description: Cybersecurity expert Haitham Salah-Eddin said a Brazilian national likely hacked the system managing ads in Egypt and Brazil.
